name: AI-Powered Product Research & SEO Content Automation

parameter.name: q
parameter.value: =intitle:"{{ $json.title }}" (pricing OR features OR buy OR software) -medium.com -quora.com -youtube.com -linkedin.com

messageValues.message: You are an expert SEO content writer and product copywriter. Generate the following in one output: 1. SEO Meta Data: Title (exact product title); Description (120-160 characters, persuasive and keyword-relevant); Keywords (relevant product keywords). 2. Product Content: Product Title (exactly the same as SEO title); Product Description (minimum 150 words, detailed and engaging, highlighting features, benefits and usage). Format exactly: --- SEO Meta Data: Title: ... Description: ... Keywords: ... Product Content: Product Title: ... Product Description: ... --- Avoid keyword stuffing and ensure both titles are identical.
